author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before: a straight-sided ghost outline around a round ring with one bar, which read as a no-entry sign or ghost. After: a domed hood whose sides flare out into three scalloped shoulder flaps, around a tall rounded-rectangle grille whose top, middle bar and bottom give the reference's three horizontal grille lines; reads as a kendo-style mask helmet at 48 in both themes.
omissions: Grille shown as a rounded rectangle rather than an oval so its straight top and bottom keep an exact 8 from the bar.
